notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.2.0
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello Splatians[/b]. This is yet another [b]quality-of-life patch[/b].[/h3][p]Over a year later, we are finally wrapping up some unfinished work – [b]mainly the music[/b]. [/p][p]Several areas were still using [i]placeholder[/i] tracks, and I had planned to remix some of [b]DarksSilencer[/b]'s pieces. Key spots like the S.P.A.R.K environment, [i]quantum labs[/i], and even the common boss theme were left incomplete. I always wanted the common boss theme to echo Lord Ashen's motif, so we have revisited and updated them.[/p][p]By the way, [url="https://www.youtube.com/@DarksSilencer"]give @DarksSilencer a YT sub[/url] - such neat indie music artists deserve more especially now![/p][h3]And then Lord Ashen appeared again.[/h3][p]The event lined up with [b]chocolatecake5000[/b]'s run uncovering another [i]softlock[/i] – perfect excuse to bundle bug fixes and music updates together.[/p][h3]Here's what's changed[/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed Library Tunnel [b]softlock[/b] reported by [b]chocolatecake5000[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential [b]softlock[/b] in [b]Quantum Power Area[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Replaced S.P.A.R.K., Quantum, and Storage Area themes with original music tracks[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced common boss theme with a new track by [url="https://www.youtube.com/@DarksSilencer"]DarksSilencer[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Updated Tomb and Arcade Boss battle themes with new originals[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Call to Action[/h3][p]Our first year was rough. We need your help to bring Desaturation more visibility. Share it with streamers or creators you know – most players who tried it enjoyed it.[/p][p]Thanks for being part of Splatland and helping close the book on the Desaturation project.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.9e
notes.notes:
Hello Splatians. This is a small hotfix.

[b]Here's what is changed:[/b]

In the [b]Corrupted Castle[/b], in the last room before entering the Ceremony Hall, if you are in a fight with the enemy and backtrack a little bit, and touch certain Holo-force-field wall, you can get saved in a very bad place, ending with, yes, the true reason for an emergency hotfix.... another softlock...

Again found by a streamer. Thank you, @Retr0_k

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.9d

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.9c

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.9
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Splatians[/b]. Another quality of live patch.

Kudos to community member and small streamer [b]Wankicha[/b] for finding very rare glitch that causes a barrel in Viscosity And Splattering to disappear. Well, the barrel never disappeared, it just got flinged into the stratosphere, or into the core void - as you decide to name it.

The game got some optimizations and some small quality of life improvements, too.

[b]Here's what's new & changed:[/b]

[list]
[*] Viscosity & Splattering - barrel bug fixed.
[*] Lord Ashen will never remove colored strips from itself during a specific battle
[*] The Rainbow Crystal of Essence can now double-hit Lord Ashen.
[*] Removed some enemy souls in the second area of Soul Realm
[*] Fixed some bugs of the JRPG Battle System (again)
[*] Removed a slime with Black Crystal protection in the Soul realm.
[*] Changed how the paint looks at some surfaces.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/55ec815fd36e5938fce39dffff86c049b155c10c.png[/img]

[b]For those who actually read patch notes:[/b]
We love you! If you love Desaturation, tell your friends about it!

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.8
notes.notes:
This patch fixes multiple issues found by community members. Kudos to tajskiKoks for the most important fixes.

[list]
[*] In the [b]Abandoned Mineshaft[/b] a barrel can get saved right on the moment when it explodes, bypassing softlock detection mechanism for this specific barrel. Now, the game will ignore any explosions that happen during load, the barrel will still explode, but the Splatian won't be harmed.
[*] While wearing the [b]Atom Hat[/b], you can end up softlocked in the [b]Control Area[/b]. It's now possible to exit this area.
[/list]

Some small issues related to input handling was fixed and some performance optimizations done in various places.

[/list]

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.6
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Splatians[/b]. This is yet another quality of live patch.

Community Member Atrix decided to use some [i]weird characters[/i] in his Steam name,
which made the evil Soul inside of the Arcade machine in Splatron's Workshop go wild and... crash the game! 

[b]Here's everything that is changed in this build:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed Splatron's Workshop Arcade crash
[*] Changed how the paints look everywhere
[*] Fixed most graphical flickering when transparent objects are painted
[*] Fixed bugs in a secret [i]First Person Challenge[/i] mode, accessible by [b]naming him[/b] in a special way.
[*] Fixed all glass rendering issues
[*] Seriously optimized the Corrupted Castle! It will now run much smoothly
[*] Fixed getting the Super Secret Ending if you never [i]flipped that switch[/i] 100 times.
[*] Many more important and polishing fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.4

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.3
notes.notes:
This small patch only fixes one thing:

In the Soul Realm JRPG Final Boss Battle, the "Entanglement" action happens immediately when triggered, but still after Lord Ashen Turn 7.
If you enter the battle and immediately use the cultist book, it's guaranteed that the Entanglement will happen after turn 7, making the final battle consistent!

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.2
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Splatians[/b]. This is yet another quality of live patch.

[b]Yes, we had a secret ending[/b] that we decided to cut before the release, because it wasn't fully polished. But it looks like there was at least one way to trigger this extra content and get some missing dialogue that stalled the entire True Ending sequence, and at least one of you discovered this bugged mess. 

it was a glitch related to the Atom Hat and the Golden Relics.

[b]We've decided to just add this ending back[/b] & make it much easier to trigger. And we also fixed everything related to your Splatian's legacy. For you, secret seekers & Atom Hat lovers, the Ceremony Hall is important thing, but the Modular Factory is also important!

[b]Here's what's new & changed:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]The Super Secret Ending is now easier to discover![/b]
[*] Getting any of the 3 endings will now return you to the Temple prior the Final Battle
[*] Carefully checked the [b]Alex Taylor Secret Quest[/b] (Library & quantum MFA)
[*] Made many fixes to "Amnesia" chain, especially in the Soul Realm
[*] Removed the first Red Soul in the Soul Realm Entrance
[*] Slightly nerfed the souls in Soul Realm Pool Table
[*] Removed some enemy souls in the Soul Realm Maze
[*] Fixed some bugs of the JRPG Battle System
[*] Added some strong hints during the Final Phase of the JRPG Final Battle
[*] Fixed many dialogue issues in the Chinese translation
[/list]

[b]For those who actually read patch notes:[/b]
Library - Atom Hat - Ceremony Hall - MFA Switch - Relics - SlimRemote

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Splatians.[/b] This is another quality of live patch + a community Chinese localization for the game.

[h2]Here's what's new & changed:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed some glitches related to DemonWare behavior
[*] Made the SlimRemote Equip button in the briefcase screen actually work
[*] Fixed the display in [i]Current & Information[/i]
[*] Added a cable in [i]Current & Information[/i] to hint more about that puzzle
[*] Fixed minor bug in the Realm of the souls.
[*] Fixed a shader that was causing some issues on Steam Deck. 
[*] [b]ADDED Simplified Chinese community localization to the game.[/b]
[/list]
Note for [b]AMD Radeon[/b] users. A MAJOR issue have been identified caused by [i]third party overlays[/i] and the [i]AMD Adrenaline overlay[/i] on some systems. 

If you have a high-end gaming system and [i]Desaturation[/i] lags, please attempt to disable Discord's overlay and AMD Adrenaline's overlay. This may improve your performance. We don't have access to a system where this slowdown occurs with Desaturation, but some people reported that these fixes work! Try updating your drivers and closing software that may interfere with the game.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.9
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Splatians![/b] We're happy to announce that a big quality of live patch that [b]adds some neat things[/b] and [b]fixes some stupid[/b] bugs is now a thing. 

[b]Here's what's changed:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]New mechanic: [/b]S.L.I.M.E. will not kill you if some of your colors match theirs.
[*] [b]The Power Generator[/b] in S.P.A.R.K. is now cycling its colors to keep being a challenge.
[*] [b]Added overlays to the map[/b] for the pipeline, crystals and relic quests when you unlock them.
[*] [b]Barrels [/b]now actually have [b]rolling sound[/b] and [b]collision sound[/b].
[*] [b]Moving platforms[/b] also have sound effects when they are moving.
[*] Fixed environmental sounds in most levels, especially underground.
[*] Fixed Eaden's Store Item Slots becoming non-interractable after being cancelled
[*] The Status screen unlocks earlier
[*] Added missing collision in [b]Modular Factory Area[/b]
[*] Added extra cables to [b]Copper Tunnel[/b] and [b]Dwellings[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed achievements:[/b] Splatterhouse, Water Cooler, Power On, Crystals Of Essence
[*] The Laser traps in [b]Dwellings[/b] will now visibly break when activated.
[*] Fixed [i]potential[/i] soft-locks in some places.
[/list]

[b]Call To Action[/b]
Feel free to share the game with [i]streamers [/i]and [i]content creators[/i] you know! 
[u]We need your help to make Desaturation successful.[/u]

[b]Community Translation Initiative[/b]
There is a community localization initiative ongoing in our Discord server.

That's it, thanks for being part of Splatland and helping shut-down the horrible Desaturation project.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello Splatians. Community member AirKris discovered a soft-lock down there in the Copper Mines... 

Silly me, silly me! An [b]explosive canister[/b] too close to a [b]save checkpoint[/b] is definitely a recipe for save-file-apocalypse...

Anyways, this is now fixed!

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Splatians![/b] Improving, improving, improving... This small update is here merely to fix newly discovered critical softlocks and do some small improvements

Here's what's changed:

1. If you get stubborn enough and move the crate in the Reception out of the yellow pool, it will reset. (Thanks Mr. Necrotic)
2. In the Forest Tunnel there were some places that you can go out of bounds. They were fixed (Thanks to AirKris and OneMore)
3. Fixed some typos in Bulgarian translation (Thanks myself and Pumzow)
4. Some minor fixes to Corrupted Castle
5. Small adjustments to Slime AI, in preparation for the upcoming Slime Update.

[b]Reminder, we heard your feedback about difficulty![/b]
We are working on providing a difficulty setting for easier slimes and less deaths due to this, but we will keep the original challenging slime mode for those of you who want some challenge and it will remain the default.

[b]Call To Action[/b]
Feel free to share the game with streamers and content creators you know! We need your help to make Desaturation successful.

[b]Community Translation Initiative[/b]
We will soon start an initiative for community translation. If you want the game translated to your language, feel free to tell us in our Discord.

That's it, thanks for being part of Splatland and helping shut-down the horrible [i]Desaturation[/i] project.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Splatians![/b] A community Member discovered an interesting but very serious progression bug that may end you permanently stuck in the Divine Station Area. 

And while as usual, we blame [i]Lord Ashen[/i] for these, it was very stupid oversight.

[b]Here's what's changed:[/b]

1. Fixed the Copper Mine Station's Left Blockade area not blocking access to Divine Station. It's no longer  possible to enter Divine Station before it's intended time in the story.
2. If you are already stuck in the Divine Station area, The tunnel is now unlocked for you to backtrack and continue your run.
3. Added some cables and minor hints to places to hint you what to do.
4. Fixed the music in the Battle Of Balance (in Ceremony Hall).

5. [b]Steam Deck:[/b] We removed the Share/Import buttons on Steam Deck - using these can crash your deck and/or get the game into weird corrupted state. 

We're very sorry if you entered Western Village Area and got stuck in there. 

[b]And we heard your feedback about difficulty![/b]
We are working on providing a difficulty setting for easier slimes and less deaths due to this, but we will keep the original challenging slime mode for those of you who  want some challenge and it will remain the default.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Splatians.[/b] We had quite interesting launch day.
Some of you discovered [b]some interesting things[/b], in the good sense, but some of you discovered bugs. Nothing serious, except some really annoying rocks and lava!

As usual, we [i]blame Lord Ashen for them[/i], and squish them the same way we do with Slimes.

[b]Here is what's changed:[/b]

1. While nothing critical, we [b]dug some hole[/b] in a certain level so you won't need to reload your save because of soft-lock. P.s. you can tap Delete to reset checkpoint if you are playing with keyboard.
2. [b]The Basement Boss room was fixed[/b].
3. Fixed some minor z-fighting graphical glitches - there are some remaining, too.
4. Fixed some [b]very annoying section[/b] in the Mines, about rocks.
5. Fixed [b]Discord's Rich presence[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/8450c982f9426c30b257c42b86a6b96a91d2879e.jpg[/img]
It now shows proper map percentage, and we added your death counter.
6. Fixed the Map Percentage in the status screen, too.

Minor stuff, but as a very small indie I want to be a good example of how I'm going to maintain the game.

With this in mind, what's next on the roadmap... is doing further polish and considering a mod support + level editor. [b]And community localizations![/b]
